_meta.purpose: Authoritative merged event dataset for the Trenton, Missouri directory. Merged from Team A (A1) and Team B (B1) field research per RULINGS.md.
_meta.note: `recurrence` is the stable, evergreen fact and is what page copy should lead with. `startDate` and `endDate` are volatile and are null wherever sources disagreed. Dates that are published need an annual review before each season.

events.name: Missouri Day Festival
events.summary: Trenton's autumn community festival, held at the North Central Missouri Fairgrounds and organized by the Trenton Area Chamber of Commerce. It includes a parade, a statewide high school marching band competition, children's activities, demonstrators and craft, antique and food vendors.
events.notes: The name is singular: Missouri Day, not Missouri Days. It is a different event from the Missouri Days Marching Festival, and the two names must never be normalised into one. No vendor count is published: four different figures appeared across sources. Duration has varied between two and four days by year, so no fixed duration is stated. The parade is reported as Saturday morning at Main and 9th Streets, sponsored by the Rotary Club of Trenton.

events.name: North Central Missouri Fair
events.summary: A multi-day summer fair at the Trenton fairgrounds with livestock competitions and animal shows, a carnival, live music, a parade, motorsports and grandstand events.
events.recurrence: annual, late July into early August
events.notes: Three different date spans appeared across the two research passes for overlapping years, so no dates are published. No official website was found, only a social page. The fairgrounds address is unresolved and held null on the venue listing too.

events.name: Mid-America Music Festival
events.summary: A two-day country music and camping festival on the grounds of Black Silo Winery, with food vendors, a wine tent, beer stations, shopping vendors and camping. It is the main fundraiser for the Black Silo Foundation.
events.notes: Lineup framing varies by year across sources, so genre description is kept generic. Ticketing, parking and camping reservations are handled on the festival's own site.

events.name: Main Street Trenton Farmer's Market
events.summary: A weekly producer market in Sesquicentennial Park in downtown Trenton with locally grown vegetables, fruit, flowers, eggs, honey and baked goods, plus handmade goods.

seasonal.note: Weekly on Saturdays during the season.

events.notes: Farmers markets of the same name exist in Trenton, Michigan and Trenton, New Jersey, and both outrank this one in search. The slug, page title and H1 must carry Trenton, MO disambiguation.

events.name: Downtown Christmas
events.summary: An annual holiday celebration in downtown Trenton on the first Friday of December, with a lighted parade, a gingerbread and cookie contest, a soup supper, live music, holiday musical presentations and a Santa appearance at the Sesquicentennial Park gazebo.
events.organizer: Main Street Trenton and Five Points Alive
events.notes: Sources use at least four names for this: Downtown Christmas, Downtown Christmas Extravaganza, Christmas in a Small Town and Trenton Christmas Parade. It may be one event or an umbrella with named components; that is unresolved. One report gives a December 1 parade date that does not fall on a first Friday, so no dates are published. The parade is reported to form at Farmers Bank of Northern Missouri and to stop at the town's nursing homes before reaching downtown.
